title: pause and resume: a finished run's workspace is saved, its box is freed, and a later run can resume from it

results.name: a finished run saves its workspace and its box is destroyed
resuming restores the saved files into a new box
the resumed agent read the same file content
a run without resumeFrom starts empty
resuming from an unknown run is refused

cost.note: saving the workspace adds about 4 s per run: small runs took 14-16 s admit-to-finish vs about 10 s of in-box phases
cost.storage: R2 bucket terrarium-workspaces, snapshots expire after 7 days
